name: Reg.exe
description: Reg is a Windows utility used to interact with the Windows Registry. It can be used at the command-line interface to query, add, modify, and remove information. Utilities such as Reg are known to be used by persistent threats.
summary: Interact with and modify the Windows Registry of a local or remote system
Gather details from the Windows Registry of a local or remote system
Check for installed software on the system
Retrieve proxy information in the Registry

associated_apts.name: APT29
associated_apts.description: APT29 has used the `reg save` command to extract LSA secrets offline. APT29 has used the `reg save` command to save registry hives.
associated_apts.sources: Mandiant APT29 Eye Spy Email Nov 22 https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/unc3524-eye-spy-email

associated_apts.name: APT41
associated_apts.description: APT41 extracted user account data from the Security Account Managerr (SAM), making a copy of this database from the registry using the reg save command or by exploiting volume shadow copies.

associated_apts.name: BianLian Ransomware Group
associated_apts.evidence: reported by CISA AA23-136A BianLian Ransomware Group May 2023
associated_apts.description: reg.exe add "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server" /v fAllowToGetHelp /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f ("Adds/overwrites a new Registry value to allow a user to receive help from Remote Assistance.")
associated_apts.sources: CISA AA23-136A BianLian Ransomware Group May 2023 https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-136a

associated_apts.name: Chimera
associated_apts.description: Chimera has queried Registry keys using reg query \<host>\HKU\<SID>\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client\Servers and reg query \<host>\HKU\<SID>\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings.

associated_apts.name: Daggerfly
associated_apts.description: Daggerfly has used Reg to dump various Windows registry hives from victim machines. Daggerfly used Reg to dump the Security Account Manager (SAM) hive from victim machines for follow-on credential extraction. Daggerfly used Reg to dump the Security Account Manager (SAM), System, and Security Windows registry hives from victim machines.

associated_apts.name: Dragonfly
associated_apts.description: Dragonfly has modified the Registry to perform multiple techniques through the use of Reg.

associated_apts.name: Earth Lusca
associated_apts.description: Earth Lusca modified the registry using the command reg add “HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Environment” /v UserInitMprLogonScript /t REG_SZ /d “[file path]” for persistence.

associated_apts.name: Ember Bear
associated_apts.description: Ember Bear acquires victim credentials by extracting registry hives such as the Security Account Manager through commands such as reg save.
associated_apts.sources: Cadet Blizzard emerges as novel threat actor https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/06/14/cadet-blizzard-emerges-as-a-novel-and-distinct-russian-threat-actor/; CISA GRU29155 2024 https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/2024-09/aa24-249a-russian-military-cyber-actors-target-us-and-global-critical-infrastructure.pdf

associated_apts.name: FIN13
associated_apts.description: FIN13 has extracted the SAM and SYSTEM registry hives using the `reg.exe` binary for obtaining password hashes from a compromised machine.

associated_apts.name: GALLIUM
associated_apts.description: GALLIUM used reg commands to dump specific hives from the Windows Registry, such as the SAM hive, and obtain password hashes.

associated_apts.name: Gamaredon Group
associated_apts.description: Gamaredon Group has used Reg to add Run keys to the Registry. Gamaredon Group has used various legitimate tools, such as `mshta.exe` and Reg, and services during operations. Gamaredon Group has replicated to removable media by leveraging the User Assist Reg Key and creating LNKs on all network and removable drives available on the infected host.

associated_apts.name: Kimsuky
associated_apts.description: Kimsuky has run reg add ‘HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\SpecialAccounts\UserList’ /v to hide a newly created user.

associated_apts.name: Lotus Blossom
associated_apts.description: Lotus Blossom has run commands such as `reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\[service name]\Parameters` to verify if installed implants are running as a service.

associated_apts.name: Mustang Panda
associated_apts.description: Mustang Panda has used vssadmin to create a volume shadow copy and retrieve the NTDS.dit file. Mustang Panda has also used reg save on the SYSTEM file Registry location to help extract the NTDS.dit file.
associated_apts.sources: Secureworks BRONZE PRESIDENT December 2019 https://www.secureworks.com/research/bronze-president-targets-ngos; Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023 https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/stately-taurus-attacks-se-asian-government/

associated_apts.name: OilRig
associated_apts.description: OilRig has used reg.exe to modify system configuration. OilRig has used reg query “HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Terminal Server Client\Default” on a victim to query the Registry.
associated_apts.sources: Trend Micro Earth Simnavaz October 2024 https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/j/earth-simnavaz-cyberattacks.html; Symantec Crambus OCT 2023 https://www.security.com/threat-intelligence/crambus-middle-east-government; Palo Alto OilRig May 2016 http://researchcenter.paloaltonetworks.com/2016/05/the-oilrig-campaign-attacks-on-saudi-arabian-organizations-deliver-helminth-backdoor/

associated_apts.name: Turla
associated_apts.description: Turla surveys a system upon check-in to discover information in the Windows Registry with the reg query command. Turla has also retrieved PowerShell payloads hidden in Registry keys as well as checking keys associated with null session named pipes.
associated_apts.sources: Kaspersky Turla https://securelist.com/the-epic-turla-operation/65545/; ESET Turla PowerShell May 2019 https://www.welivesecurity.com/2019/05/29/turla-powershell-usage/

associated_apts.name: Volt Typhoon
associated_apts.description: Volt Typhoon has queried the Registry on compromised systems, `reg query hklm\software\`, for information on installed software including PuTTY.
associated_apts.sources: CISA AA24-038A PRC Critical Infrastructure February 2024 https://www.cisa.gov/sites/default/files/2024-03/aa24-038a_csa_prc_state_sponsored_actors_compromise_us_critical_infrastructure_3.pdf; Joint Cybersecurity Advisory Volt Typhoon June 2023 https://media.defense.gov/2023/May/24/2003229517/-1/-1/0/CSA_Living_off_the_Land.PDF

associated_campaigns.name: APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign
associated_campaigns.description: During APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign, APT28 used the following commands to dump SAM, SYSTEM, and SECURITY hives: reg save hklm\sam, reg save hklm\system, and reg save hklm\security.

associated_campaigns.name: Operation CuckooBees
associated_campaigns.description: During Operation CuckooBees, the threat actors leveraged a custom tool to dump OS credentials and used following commands: `reg save HKLM\SYSTEM system.hiv`, `reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hiv`, and `reg save HKLM\SECURITY security.hiv`, to dump SAM, SYSTEM and SECURITY hives.

associated_campaigns.name: Operation Digital Eye
associated_campaigns.description: During Operation Digital Eye, threat actors used `reg save` to retrieve credentials from the Security Account Manager (SAM) database.

associated_campaigns.name: Operation Wocao
associated_campaigns.description: During Operation Wocao, the threat actors executed `/c cd /d c:\windows\temp\ & reg query HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\<username>\PuTTY\Sessions\` to detect recent PuTTY sessions, likely to further lateral movement.

associated_malware.name: BabyShark

associated_malware.name: Epic

associated_malware.name: HeartCrypt

associated_malware.name: POWRUNER

associated_malware.name: RATANKBA
associated_malware.description: RATANKBA uses the command reg query “HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\InternetSettings”.

associated_malware.name: SMOKEDHAM
associated_malware.description: SMOKEDHAM has used reg.exe to create a Registry Run key.

associated_malware.name: The Gentlemen Ransomware
associated_malware.description: The Gentlemen Ransomware has written registry keys within HKLM and HKCU to gain persistence device wide and to have redundancy. The Gentlemen Ransomware has added registry keys to maintain persistence through `reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run /v GupdateS /t REG_SZ /d “<malware_path>” /f` and `reg add HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run /v GupdateU /t REG_SZ /d “<malware_path>” /f`.

associated_malware.name: Ursnif
associated_malware.description: Ursnif has used Reg to query the Registry for installed programs.

associated_malware.name: Zebrocy
associated_malware.description: Zebrocy executes the reg query command to obtain information in the Registry.
